The main takeaway from our work is that
amphiphilic graft copolymeyer polymers can be used to reduce protein adsorption at PUR surfaces, both when present in a PUR matrix, as well as when adsorbed at the surfaces.
the adsorption of amphiphilic graft copolymer blends at the surface of PUR can be controlled by adjusting their composition, which can be used to tailor the adsorption of proteins at the surface.
